notes.title: DearCraft Developer Twitter
notes.content:

notes.title: 0.6.5C version update!
notes.content:
update content:
1. Increase the default lighting shadow rendering.
2. Correct the change between day and night.
3. Add a new box: Conveyor belt. Uses: Manufacturing automatic production lines.

notes.title: DearCraft Notice
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We have submitted our game on April 24, 2019.
Currently in the STEAM review phase,
The specific unlocking time is subject to the STEAM audit.
Thank you for your patience.

Fairy Studio
